verdict.rationale: TypeScript DX is a fair axis for a UI framework, so it applies. React's docs only say TypeScript support comes from adding @types/react and that you "can provide types for your component's props". That describes writing explicit prop annotations, not automatic inference. Nothing in the pack covers automatic inference of props or emitted events.

support.subject: As a developer, I can get automatic type inference for component props and emitted events without writing extra type annotations
